headline: Sarvam releases open-weight Prism decision model on Sarvam 105B
quote: Prism’s weights are on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 licence.
claim: Sarvam released Prism on 3 Nov 2026, a decision model built on Sarvam 105B; Sarvam reports it scores 71.8 at 44 ms on a B200 GPU among 25 decision models tested. Weights are on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0.
why_it_matters: An Apache-licensed Indian model you can download and run on one large GPU, with vendor-reported benchmarks to test yourself.
title: Sarvam Prism: a decision model built on Sarvam 105B | Sarvam AI

headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils EKA-1, Dhir 2B and Dhir 5B models
quote: Soket's 26.3 billion parameter EKA-1 model has been trained on nearly 7.5 trillion tokens and supports all 22 scheduled Indian languages as well as English.
claim: Soket's EKA-1 (26.3 billion parameters) and ZenteiQ's Dhir 2B and 5B were unveiled in New Delhi before IT secretary S Krishnan. They are accessible via AIKosh, and ZenteiQ released weights under Apache 2.0.
why_it_matters: Government-backed Indian models with downloadable weights on AIKosh give you free bases for Indic-language projects.

headline: IndiaAI cuts minimum bid to 512 units in 10,000-GPU tender
quote: The revised tender timetable sets November 13, 2026, as the bid submission deadline, with technical bids scheduled to open on November 14.
claim: The IndiaAI procurement round now needs 512 compute units at one Indian data centre, down from 1,000, and seeks up to 10,000 additional units. Bids are due 13 Nov 2026 and technical bids open 14 Nov.
why_it_matters: More mid-size providers can join the subsidised GPU pool, which may widen cheap compute for student and startup projects.
title: IndiaAI Mission Cuts Minimum Compute Capacity Requirement to 512 Units for New 10,000-GPU Tender - Lapaas Voice
